name: Orbit to formation
look: One set of square photographs rides a single invisible wheel that changes shape as the page scrolls: a huge arch turning over the opening statement, then a ring closing round one big figure, then a half-wheel at the edge of the screen beside a column of figures that light one by one. It is one continuous set piece for a team, a culture, a gallery or an archive, in place of three separate galleries.
reduced: The finished composition: the markup as the page writes it, nothing moving.
phone: The same wheel with phone numbers: a tall ten-card ring, then the wheel sinks to the bottom edge instead of rolling aside and the figures rise out from behind it; hold 4.
place: In the middle, on the about, the gallery or the figures: the stretch that says who the people are or how long the place has been there. Hold 4, the lowest the scene file allows (it raises a lower hold to 4 and still defaults to 5): where the sheet gives less, set {"hold":4}. Not on the work: its cards are small, so the work is shown at size elsewhere.
content: Twelve to sixteen distinct square photographs (14 by default; phones use the first ten), 560px or more, in one grade, the subject inside the central 60% so a tilted or upside-down card still reads. Never the same picture twice, at most two from one source (one film, one shoot, one building) and never side by side; with fewer than twelve distinct pictures, redraw rather than repeat them (the script repeats a short set whole, which reads as padding). People, hands and studio moments only when they are the client's own; otherwise real pictures of its world (the place, its materials, its work in use: modern, well-lit photographs, never archive or documentary ones), never stand-ins for its team. A statement of 6-10 words that holds two lines (about 45 characters keeps the full size). One figure of 4 glyphs or fewer (a year, a count) with an optional second line of 3 words or fewer, and a caption of 12 words or fewer. Four rows of figures (2-6 work), each of 4 glyphs or fewer with a label of 4 words or fewer: real facts about the subject from the brief (a year, a height, a number of rooms or days), never invented business numbers, never a constant of the medium (25 frames a second) or a figure worked out from another on the list; count true only with such real figures.
options: hold 4 (4-7); phoneHold 4 (3-6); scrub 0.6, locked with Lenis; radius 1 (0.7-1.6) the arch's radius as a share of the width, 0.7 steep, 1.6 flat; crest 0.24 (0.18-0.30) height of the arch's top card; phoneCrest 'auto' or 0.14-0.44; ring 0.46 (0.36-0.48) the ring's width, spilling past the frame from 0.44; stagger 0.2 (0-0.5) how far the cards peel off one after another; wind 'close' | 'spring'; tilt 1 (the faces follow the wheel) or 0.2-0.9 (the faces stay near upright); dim 0.4 (0.4-0.8) opacity of a figure row off the reading line; count false (true counts each figure up as it lights); phone 'same' | 'rest'; phoneCards 10 (6-14).
